decisions.reason: The source changes only the landing-page book cover's size and preserves full-edge visibility. The broader landing-page copy and layout requirements remain valid unchanged.
The book-cover presentation change does not alter any FAQ copy or FAQ topic.
The source concerns the landing-page book cover, not the About-page content or its unresolved reward-copy question.
Changing the landing-page book cover size does not change the current or planned product name.
The source does not change email authentication or dashboard-access behavior.
The source does not affect transactional-email delivery, notifications, or confirmation-email contents.
The landing-page cover adjustment has no effect on SIWE or wallet-based access.
The source does not change public API authentication or exposed information.
The source changes only the visual presentation of the cover on the landing page, not NFT-holder eligibility, Lit Protocol gating, or ownership checks.
The source does not affect automatic prize payout or any prize-claim behavior.
The landing-page cover sizing decision does not change which book rights, referral identity, badges, or tickets follow an NFT transfer.
The source does not alter the deferred Transak fiat-mint flow, provider, wallet provisioning, or supported payment methods.
